title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, our powerful new tool designed to provide you with unparalleled insights and control.

title: Master Your Media: Advanced File Control in the Editor
summary: Take complete command of your content with intuitive new tools to effortlessly upload, manage, and customize the display of all your images and documents directly within your editor.

title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new public roadmap page to keep you informed about what's shipped, what's coming next, and what's planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more fluid and visually cohesive experience with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and seamlessly integrated with the editor's design.

title: Seamless Collaborative Editing
summary: Collaborate effortlessly with your team using clearer visual cues that make co-editing more transparent and efficient than ever before.

title: Enhanced Sharing & Collaboration
summary: Now, effortlessly discover and collaborate on all your shared items, ensuring you and your team are always connected and productive.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We are thrilled to announce comprehensive support for numerous international languages, making Noeko truly accessible to users around the globe.

title: Noeko Is Now Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with ultimate control and direct involvement in shaping its future while fostering complete transparency.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your knowledge base with unprecedented clarity by filtering your Constellation view by tags and time, and effortlessly visualize shared items and connections with your friends.

title: Precision Search & Curated Collections
summary: Discover exactly what you need with powerful new filters and sorting options, then effortlessly save your refined search results as custom collections.

title: Flexible Content Views
summary: Experience a more intuitive and dynamic way to view and interact with your linked content, empowering you to seamlessly structure your ideas to match your natural thought process.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosted Freedom and Premium Power
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko with new self-hosted deployment options and flexible premium plans designed to fit your unique requirements.

title: Enhanced Visual Themes and Dynamic New Styles
summary: We are dramatically enhancing our existing themes and introducing a vibrant collection of new styles to offer a richer, more personalized visual experience.

title: Personalized Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: Experience a more welcoming and accurate homepage with greetings that thoughtfully adapt to your specific time of day.

title: Enhanced List Management & Quick Actions
summary: Gain instant control over your items and tags by performing quick actions directly from any list, enabling you to effortlessly unapply tags or delete items.

title: Bring All Your Content Together
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly import and interact with a rich array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, consolidating all your essential information in one powerful platform.
